description: Link this computer with a TV running TeleQ on the same Wi-Fi. Ask the user to open TeleQ on the TV, choose Linked devices → Link an assistant, and read you the 9-digit code. Only needed once per TV (or after it was unlinked).

code.description: The 9-digit code shown on the TV.

tv_address.description: Optional: the TV's address on the home network (like 192.168.1.20), when several TVs are found.

name: link_tv
title: Link a TV
